# Kifayat

> Kifayat is Pakistan's online shopping destination for fashion, electronics, home & kitchen, beauty, sports, and toys — with nationwide delivery and cash on delivery.

## Categories

- [Electronics](https://www.kifayat.co/category/electronics): Phones, earbuds, watches, chargers, and tech accessories.
- [Fashion](https://www.kifayat.co/category/fashion): Men's and women's fashion, shoes, and accessories.
- [Home & Kitchen](https://www.kifayat.co/category/home-kitchen): Home appliances, cookware, and kitchen essentials.
- [Beauty](https://www.kifayat.co/category/beauty): Skincare, personal care, and beauty products.
- [Sports](https://www.kifayat.co/category/sports): Sports equipment and fitness gear.
- [Toys](https://www.kifayat.co/category/toys): Toys and games for all ages.
